risks.title: Brand value erosion
risks.score_rationale: Brand value is essential to the company's success, and a decline could have serious financial consequences. The language in the report is strong and emphasizes the importance of preserving brand value.

risks.title: New market development
risks.score_rationale: Expanding into new markets is critical for growth, and risks related to new store openings and managing expansion could negatively impact financial results.

risks.title: Supply chain risks
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain risks, such as raw material shortages or quality issues, could negatively affect the company's financial performance.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: Intensifying competition in the quick-service restaurant sector could harm financial results, especially if competitors offer higher-quality products or more competitive pricing.

risks.title: Food safety risks
risks.score_rationale: Food safety risks, including contamination or product recalls, could severely impact financial results and damage the company's reputation.

risks.title: Dependence on the North American segment
risks.score_rationale: The company's reliance on the North American segment could negatively affect financial performance if this region experiences a slowdown or decline.

risks.title: Growth management risks
risks.score_rationale: Risks associated with managing growth, such as international expansion or execution of new strategies, could negatively impact financial results.

ai_positioning.summary: SBUX does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on the company's financial and operational aspects.
